# helia_profiler API reference

> The entry points of the heliaPROFILER Python API: one call, one session, and the progress stream they report through.

The reference is generated from the python source. The JSON is the source of truth and the pages are a view of it.

## Modules

- [helia_profiler](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/): The entry points of the heliaPROFILER Python API: one call, one session, and the progress stream they report through. ([JSON](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler.json), [Markdown](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler.md))
- [helia_profiler.config](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/config/): The run description: what to profile, on what, how, and what to write out. ([JSON](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/config.json), [Markdown](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/config.md))
- [helia_profiler.config.power](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/config/power/): Power capture settings: which instrument measures the rail, how it is wired to the board, and which window of the run is integrated. ([JSON](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/config/power.json), [Markdown](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/config/power.md))
- [helia_profiler.deps](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/deps/): What this build of heliaPROFILER is qualified against: the board, engine and toolchain matrix, and the locked dependency revisions a run was produced with. ([JSON](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/deps.json), [Markdown](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/deps.md))
- [helia_profiler.diagnostics](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/diagnostics/): Collecting a redacted support bundle from a run directory, and reading one back. ([JSON](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/diagnostics.json), [Markdown](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/diagnostics.md))
- [helia_profiler.errors](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/errors/): The exception hierarchy every heliaPROFILER failure is raised through, rooted at HpxError. ([JSON](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/errors.json), [Markdown](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/errors.md))
- [helia_profiler.evaluation](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/evaluation/): Comparing two runs and judging one: the comparability rules that decide whether a comparison is meaningful, and the metric policies that turn numbers into a ve… ([JSON](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/evaluation.json), [Markdown](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/evaluation.md))
- [helia_profiler.examples](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/examples/): Packaged model and config assets used by the examples, smoke tests and tutorials. ([JSON](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/examples.json), [Markdown](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/examples.md))
- [helia_profiler.modelcost](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/modelcost/): The static cost model of a network, read from the model file before anything is built or run. ([JSON](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/modelcost.json), [Markdown](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/modelcost.md))
- [helia_profiler.power](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/power/): What a power capture produces: the measured result, the observations behind it, and the on-device summary the firmware reports. ([JSON](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/power.json), [Markdown](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/power.md))
- [helia_profiler.power.metadata](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/power/metadata/): The provenance of a power number: how it was observed, what the measurement boundary included, and whether the capture holds together. ([JSON](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/power/metadata.json), [Markdown](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/power/metadata.md))
- [helia_profiler.results](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/results/): What a profiling run produces: the run result, its per-layer and PMU detail, and the firmware and run metadata that say how it was measured. ([JSON](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/results.json), [Markdown](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/results.md))
- [helia_profiler.results.manifest](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/results/manifest/): The on-disk index of a run directory: the artifacts it holds, the issues raised against it, and whether its numbers may be used. ([JSON](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/results/manifest.json), [Markdown](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/results/manifest.md))
- [helia_profiler.vocab](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/vocab/): The fixed vocabularies a configuration selects from: engines, toolchains, capture transports, memory placements and reset strategies. ([JSON](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/vocab.json), [Markdown](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/helia_profiler/vocab.md))

## Machine-readable

- [reference.json](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/reference.json): every module in one document, against https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-ui/schema/reference-model-1.json
- [llms-full.txt](https://ambiqai.github.io/helia-profiler/reference/api/llms-full.txt): every module page as Markdown, in order
